speaker: counselor
text: How is the new apartment working out?

speaker: student
text: Not great. My roommates stay up until three in the morning and I cannot study.

speaker: counselor
text: Have you talked with them about it?

speaker: student
text: I tried once. They said I am too sensitive, so now I just stay quiet.

speaker: student
text: I feel like an outsider in my own home. Nobody asks me to join dinner.

speaker: student
text: I signed for twelve months and the rent is more than I planned. If I move I lose the deposit.

speaker: counselor
text: Is money a worry for you?

speaker: student
text: Every week. My scholarship covers tuition but not rent, and I do not know how to ask the housing office for help.

speaker: student
text: I do not even know which office to go to. I'm embarrassed to ask again after they gave me the wrong form.
